function.name: commit
function.description: Phase 0 only (turns 1-3). Register your convention answers for the opening menu slots, sealed until the build opens, then public. One per seat per episode.

slots.description: Map slot_id -> chosen value, covering exactly the opening menu slots.

function.name: read
function.description: Load a file into your open-file register (capacity 6, least-recently-read evicted; open files always render current content). Open files render in your panel.

function.name: write
function.description: Replace a file whole (at most 80 lines, 10 files total). SPEC.md, SPEC_ADDENDUM.md, and tests_public.py are engine artifacts and illegal targets.

function.name: run
function.description: Execute the public suite on the workspace. Costs 1 shared run credit. Results render for everyone.

function.name: probe
function.description: QA only. Costs 1 probe credit. Returns pass/fail for one hidden test on the current workspace, to QA alone. test_id must be copied exactly from the current QA probe catalog; code function names are not test IDs.

test_id.description: Exact ID from the current QA probe catalog, for example h_q1; never a code function name.

function.name: release
function.description: Consume a release token; snapshot the workspace as the graded candidate. The last release is the graded artifact.

function.name: propose_iface
function.description: Open an interface contract: at most 2 bound slot values and 2 obligations, 2 or 3 named parties including you. Each binds[].slot_id must be the canonical ID shown before the parenthesized label in Conventions (for example M2, not ERR_KEY). Locks when every other named party agrees; lapses if unagreed after min(6, D - turn) turns.

slot_id.description: Canonical slot ID from Conventions, such as M2; do not use its parenthesized label, such as ERR_KEY.

function.name: agree
function.description: Accept a live contract you are named in (the proposer's standing is implicit in proposing).

function.name: report
function.description: Broadcast 1-3 structured status claims. Scope: a public test id, 'all-public', or {path, task_id}; verdict: pass, fail, or done. The engine grades each claim true or false against actual state.

function.name: query
function.description: Ask one teammate something (max 40 tokens). The third seat sees that a message was sent and to whom, never its text.

function.name: inform
function.description: Tell one teammate something (max 40 tokens). The third seat sees that a message was sent and to whom, never its text.

function.name: refuse
function.description: Decline to act on the situation or mandate.
